avis.titre: Great for adult acne, gentle but actually works
avis.texte: I’m in my 40s and still dealing with occasional breakouts, so I’m always cautious trying new products. This cleanser has been a really pleasant surprise. It starts as a clay texture and lathers into a light foam, leaving my skin feeling clean without that tight, over dried feeling. After using it consistently, I have also noticed fewer breakouts and a smoother overall texture. What I appreciate most is that it feels effective without being harsh or irritating, which is important for more mature or sensitive skin. If you are dealing with adult acne and want something that cleans well but still feels gentle, this is definitely worth trying. It works!

Really happy with this acne face wash! 🌿✨ It has a pleasant, fresh smell and feels gentle on the skin. It cleans well without making my face too dry, and I’ve noticed my skin looking clearer with regular use. Works pretty good overall and definitely worth trying if you’re looking for a simple daily face wash for acne.
It serves for three different forms of use (face wash, spot treatment, and mask). It’s great! Bought this form my son and its helped tremendously to clear out his acne.

avis.titre: Great addition to my acne skin routine
avis.texte: Helps to keep my pores clean and keep acne at bay. Has light coconut scent which I find pleasant, not fragrance-free. I have sensitive skin, have not had any issue

It was okay didn’t really do much for me. Didn’t cause any damage to my skin but also didn’t make my skin clear either. No fragrance though just a nice gentle cleanser. I also used it as a mask but just felt like I was washing my face after it sat for a while. I was expecting it to dry if I used it as acne spots & a face mask but it didn’t. I like that you can use it for multiple things though.

I love the foaminess, it also feels like my skin is softer after using it, however I’ve been using it for a couple months now and I haven’t really seen that much of a difference. No skin irritation either.
“Great skincare! Gentle, moisturizing, and very good for sensitive skin. My skin feels soft and healthy. I highly recommend CeraVe!” 💧✨

avis.titre: Simple Acne Treatment ... and simple turned out better!
avis.texte: I was looking for an acne treatment to replace my Proactiv plus system that I have been using since my inception of acne. admittedly Procativ was doing a good job at keeping my acne under control but I wanted to try something else since I was finding the pricing for Procativ and auto delivery cumbersome. I have now used the CeraVe Foam wash for about more than a month and half and it has passed the test! My acne is under control with less of the nasty large breakouts I would still get with Proactiv. My typical routine is to use this as a face wash and apply a small dab to acne overnight if I get a large blemish. I was skeptical that a one step would be as effective as the three step but here we are! I would definitely give this a shot if you have been struggling with acne.

This is a new Cerave product I have not tried. I normally do their sunscreen however I have been looking for new facial cleansers to add into my regime. I used this product when I took a bath this morning. It comes out as clay, and as you massage it on your face with some water, it turns into a light bubbling foam.

avis.titre: CeraVe has the best products- love this face wash!
avis.texte: I'm a big CeraVe fan and have a bunch of their products. I was happy to add this Acne Clay-to-Foam cleanser to my collection. It works really well and keeps my face feeling clean and moisturized. It's easy to lather into a nice foam and does a good job removing my makeup. I like that it can be used as a mask too, and is super versatile. It only requires a small amount of cleanser to use, and this will last me a long time.

I really do love this product. I can tell that it deep cleans well when Using it as a face wash. Love the option to use it as a mask. The ONLY reason I am not giving it 5 stars, is because I found a large sliver of wood in the bottle. It’s not a big deal, but then it makes me question the packaging process in the bottle and what else I could be spreading all over my face.

I’m not usually a fan of number-in-1 products, but I actually really like this Cerave Clay to Foam Acne Face Wash is pretty good! It has a much softer consistency than I was expecting for a clay product (when used as a face wash). It does have a thicker clay-like appearance at first, but it foams up nicely without any patches of clay sticking. It’s truly unscented, and isn’t an overly stripping formula. It leaves my skin feeling clean and smooth, and is fairly gentle on my skin. If using as a mask, I do recommend applying a very thin layer so that your skin doesn’t feel tight after washing from using too much product. It does dry like a typical clay mask does, so you can see the spots you put this product on if using it as a spot treatment… But, it’s not itchy or irritating, and prevents me from trying to pick at the spots. This is definitely a quality product I would expect from Cerave, and I could see myself repurchasing this!

I love this multi use face wash. It is great as a cleanser and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. It lathers well and is easy to rinse. It also works great as a spot treatment. It is a thicker formula that stays in place. It is gentle on my skin and doesn't use strong fragrance which I like. This has become my go-to cleanser and I will buy again.

I'm really enjoying this face cleanser. It feels like both a face wash and a mask all in one. The product comes out a little thick like a clay mask usually does but once you rub it between your hands it melts into a sort of cleanser tyle of product. I just want to give a heads up that it does have that slight clay mask smell to it as you apply it, but it goes away once it's on your face. I don't mind it, but others might.

avis.titre: This is a nice face wash that can also be used as a mask!
avis.texte: I'm a fan of CeraVe products and this clay to foam face wash is no exception. It is great for a nice, deep clean of my pores. I have oily skin, so didn't find it too drying and there is no skin irritation. This is little scent - maybe a little bit of a clay scent, but nothing perfumy. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Clearer Skin & Gentle Enough For Sensitive Types!
avis.texte: I'm always looking for gentle yet effective skincare solutions. This treatment is great for tackling breakouts without drying out the skin! I love this for my sensitive skin. It takes consistent use, but it's worth it for a clearer complexion.

This CeraVe clay to foam wash is really nice. I love that it can be used as a face wash, mask or spot treatment. It has a thick creamy texture and it smells like coconut oil. It leaves my skin very hydrated while reducing oils and its soothing on irritated skin.

avis.titre: Perfect for my problem t zone
avis.texte: I just love this for my t-zone, it cleans really deep and no type of irritation, just gets those pores really cleaned out and still hydrating and not a drying feeling at all. Absolutely great quality and so helpful for my problem zones, just nice to see improvements in those black don’t or the lack of them per se. Definitely helpful!
